EmailTemplate.subject: Welcome to ASU New College of Interdisciplinary Arts & Sciences
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
I would like to personally congratulate you on your acceptance into the New College of Interdisciplinary Arts and Sciences! I am the Academic Success Coordinator for your program and, along with your program faculty, am here to help you navigate your program.
Additionally, as you prepare for your new semester, please review your individual Graduate Program Website found here https://newcollege.asu.edu/advising/graduate and the Program Handbook and Graduate Policies and Procedures https://graduate.asu.edu/policies-procedures.
I look forward to meeting you at orientation. For more information about registration, orientation and the acceptance form, please view this website https://newcollege.asu.edu/graduate/admission-next-steps.
Please do not hesitate to contact me with any additional questions at ncgradadvising@asu.edu.
Best,
Jan Lacey Academic Success Coordinator Arizona State University New College, Graduate Studies M/C 1251 4701 W. Thunderbird Rd. Glendale, AZ 85306-4908 (602) 543-6266 (602) 543-4565 (Fax) ncgradadvising@asu.edu
